question.text: The letters of the word $\mathrm{COCHIN}$ are permuted and all the permutations are arranged in an alphabetical order as in an English dictionary. The number of words that appear before the word $\mathrm{COCHIN}$ is

solution.text: In a word $\mathrm{COCHIN}$, the second place can be filled in ${ }^4 C_1$ ways and the remaining four alphabets can be arranged in $4 !$ ways in four different places. The next $97^{\text {th }}$ word will be COCHIN.
